thread:
sasha: Heads-up — release v1.9.0 deploy window is TOMORROW 09:00 PDT. We need docsite + SDK docs regen coordinated. Who can own the docs cutover and changelog bump? :calendar:

owen: I can take docsite deploy. Will do a dry-run today and a canary at 08:30. What are the hard cutoffs for merges?

stasha: Quick note — branch cutoff is today 17:00 PT for anything that must be in v1.9.0. After that only critical fixes and changelog updates.

tara: Putting changelog nudge here — please add short bullet (1 line) for any user-facing changes. I'll compile and format.

own: For SDK docs regen — is the pipeline still the same? `ci/docs-regen` -> publish -> CDN invalidate?

chris: Yes, pipeline unchanged. Steps: bump SDK package version in monorepo, run `yarn build:docs`, trigger `ci/docs-regen` (we still have the manual approval gate), then CDN invalidate. I'll approve the regen gate if CI is green.

sasha: Owen, can you open the docsite deploy PR early so Tara can preview changelog placement?

own: On it — creating branch `release/v1.9.0-docsite` and PR now. Will include the changelog section and the new console screenshots.

tara: FYI I updated the changelog template with the new header order. Will paste sample entry into the PR description.

docs-bot: ci/docs-regen started for branch release/v1.9.0-docsite — build 4821. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/4821 (waiting on unit tests).

sasha: Quick checklist for owners: 1) Version bump + tag PR 2) Changelog compiled and linked in PR 3) SDK docs regen approved 4) Docsite canary 08:30 5) Full deploy 09:00 6) Post-deploy smoke tests (login, console routes, search).

ochris: Adding: update redirects file if any paths changed, and reindex search if we shipped new docs pages. I can run the index job post-deploy.

own: Posted the PR: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/754 — includes changelog draft and screenshots. Please review.

tara: Reviewed and left two tiny wording nits. Sasha — can you sanity-check the “upgrade note” paragraph?

sasha: Will check in 10. If all good I'll merge after the 17:00 cutoff if no more changes.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: docsite canary for release/v1.9.0 at 2026-03-18T08:30:00-07:00, full deploy at 2026-03-18T09:00:00-07:00.

own: One more: SDK package.json bump is in PR #755, please don't merge without the docs deploy passing so published docs match SDK version.

chris: A reminder — if any API surface changed, update the SDK changelog entry and the function signatures page.

tara: I've compiled the changelog bullets; putting final list into PR body now.

sasha: Thanks all. If anything blocks the regen gate ping @chris directly — he'll approve quickly if CI is green. Otherwise we'll hold to next weekly window. :thumbsup:

own: Will monitor CI and circle back in this thread if anything flakes.

chris: Will run the search reindex and smoke tests post-deploy, report status here.

sasha: Great — status plan: if deploy is green by 09:15 we proceed with release tag and announce. If not, rollback plan is documented in the PR.

end of thread
